**Verdict: PASS.** DG2 round 8 (T-DG2-REV-DOM-R8), candidate `sha256:9331e9d13e0ffa55f35ebc25ecdf9b60e159876dc2470fe56e9241a40fea124f`. I found no new findings, so I wrote no findings sidecar.

**Candidate check.** I recomputed the candidate ID in the repository and in a disposable clone, and both match (539 files). HEAD is 4053630c, the freeze commit; its parent is the source commit cf3446e4. Since cf3446e4, only delivery records have changed. `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` passes.

**Repairs since round 7 (D-068).** None of them touches playbook text, i18n strings, seeds, the methodology catalogue, migrations or gate logic.
- **Text is still stored exactly as sent.** Arabic text with emoji and RLM/LRM marks is stored character for character, whether sent in one piece or in chunks. A leading byte order mark is accepted.
- **Bad bytes are refused.** Bodies containing invalid UTF-8 (four byte patterns, each sent both ways) get the declared 400 error and nothing is saved.
- **Arabic search still works.** Query strings built the way the web client builds them find the Arabic-named record. An undecodable query value gets a 400 error naming the field.
- **Error messages are bilingual.** Every error code involved has both an English and an Arabic message, including the new rate-limit (429) response.
- **Invisible-only input is still refused**, with the localized message in both languages.

**Full re-review of all 26 requirements:**
- **Live walk-through (101/101 checks pass).** On a fresh test stack with synthetic data I created a transformation and walked Diagnose→Define→Design. The G1, G2 and G3 demo decisions moved the phase on each time. Gates submitted out of order were refused, and the gate names match the playbook (B0023).
- **Playbook text matches the source:** the six governance roles (B0018), the two modes with their guidance (B0009), the 14 charter fields with version history, and the four-part thesis (B0037), flagged incomplete when a part is blank or invisible. Also:
  - the five scope sanity checks (B0039–B0043);
  - the 10 operating-model dimensions (B0056) and the six diagnostic workstreams (B0029);
  - the canvas prompts (B0062);
  - exactly one current North Star.
- **Outcomes and guardrails:** the 3–5 top-outcome warning appears, and the good-outcome test fails "Launch new app". G2 is blocked with zero guardrails, and G3 is blocked until its required outputs exist.
- **Design registers (11/11).** I checked the gap matrix, the decision log, the capability heatmap link, journeys with decimal cycle times, workshop items converting into decisions, and the per-dimension view.
- **Screens in Arabic (right-to-left) and English (left-to-right).** Text with Arabic, emoji and RLM marks is created and displayed exactly as entered. Invisible-only input shows the localized inline message and nothing is sent. The mode guidance shows the B0009 wording.
- **Invariants hold:**
  - `#0078FF` is marked provisional;
  - nothing claims PMI certification or official Mobily branding;
  - money and rates are stored as decimals;
  - an unquantified value pool shows no amount rather than 0;
  - only G1–G6 exist as product gates, and nothing touches DG0–DG7.

**Required checks.** Typecheck, build, lint, `pnpm test` (691/691) and the contrast check all exit 0 on both Node 22 and Node 24.

**Environmental residuals.** The live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) were checked only offline or on their configuration, as the assignment directs. I recorded them as PASS with a note, not as blocked gate checks.

**Handback location.** The write guard refused the handback path the assignment specified (`docs/delivery/handbacks/...`) as outside my write scope. As in rounds 6 and 7, I put the handback in my evidence directory instead.

**Findings:** none (no Critical, High, Medium or Low).

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG2/round-8/domain-reviewer.json (validates against the review schema)
- reviews/DG2/round-8/domain-reviewer.md
- test-evidence/DG2/domain/round-8/ (logs, scripts, 6 cited screenshots, handback-T-DG2-REV-DOM-R8-domain-reviewer.md)
